description.value: Domino's Pizza is a national pizza chain offering delivery and carryout at this West Kelowna location on Anders Road. Touring cyclists can grab a quick, filling meal by walking in for carryout or having a pizza delivered to a nearby stop. The location is part of a strip-unit commercial area and serves the broader West Kelowna community.
